name: Medlane
summary: A pharmacy point of sale and dispensary with prescriptions and expiry-dated batches
about: A nine-page point of sale and dispensary for a pharmacy with three branches in Lahore, in a light and a dark theme. The counter sells from the earliest-expiring batch, blocks prescription-only medicines until a slip is linked and warns about allergies; a prescription queue, batch stock, transfers, supplier orders and reports sit behind it. A shelf clock slides every batch toward its expiry line.
how: Pick a branch at the top; the counter, queue and stock follow it.
On Counter, tap medicines to fill the cart: each line shows the lot it will be sold from (first expiry, first out).
Rx-only items need a linked prescription before Complete sale works; pay by cash, card or wallet and the receipt prints with lot numbers.
On Prescriptions, drag a card to Checking, Ready and Collected (or use Move): Ready fills it from stock, Collected books the sale.
On Expiry, click a capsule on the shelf clock and quarantine it: it drops into the bin, and the bin can return batches to suppliers.
Receive batches with a lot and expiry date, move stock between branches, and order low items from Purchasing.
Switch Reports between 7D, 30D and 12M, and use Settings for the prescription rule, expiry warning, theme or a demo reset.
